recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. The current specification already contains the separate condition element requested by FHIR-14116, and related later changes preserve that model.
issue_request: FHIR-14116 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ResearchStudy issue from STU3. It requested adding study condition as a specifically named ResearchStudy semantic instead of including it inside the general focus element. Jira says the change was made and published in the Dec 2017 FHIR ballot.
initial_application: Commit 61b5fa5576 added ResearchStudy.condition to the old spreadsheet source immediately before ResearchStudy.focus. That initial application used Reference(Condition); later ResearchStudy work corrected the current source to CodeableConcept with a condition-code binding and carried the separate element forward through source refactors.
additional_context: FHIR-14289 is the same change family's follow-up wording/order issue. Current ResearchStudy source has since changed focus to CodeableReference through later decisions, but condition remains distinct from focus.
reconciliation: No source change was made. In active current source, ResearchStudy.condition is a 0..* CodeableConcept immediately after ResearchStudy.focus, has the short 'Condition being studied,' has its own condition-code example binding, and has its own token search parameter.

related_jiras.note: Follow-up issue to remove condition wording from ResearchStudy.focus after adding the separate condition element.
